read.json.description: Tool read: read a text file as plain lines, in parts if it is big.

ls.json.description: Tool ls: list one folder, one line per item; long and json for details.

view.json.description: Tool view: look into a file step by step: JSON level by level, big text as an outline first.

stat.json.description: Tool stat: facts about one file, folder or link as JSON (type, size, lines, format).

grep.json.description: Tool grep: search inside files with a regular expression, like grep -rn; one line PATH:LINE:TEXT per match.

glob.json.description: Tool glob: find files by name pattern (*, **, ?) under a folder; one path per line.

write.json.description: Tool write: write a whole file (new, or fully replaced).

edit.json.description: Tool edit: change part of a text file by exact text replacement.

copy.json.description: Tool copy: copy a file or a whole folder to a new path.

move.json.description: Tool move: move or rename a file, folder or link; also brings things back from the trash.

mkdir.json.description: Tool mkdir: create a folder with its parents; an existing folder is fine.

json_get.json.description: Tool json_get: the value at one FILE#/POINTER as one line of JSON; [too big] when over max_bytes.

json_ls.json.description: Tool json_ls: what is inside one place of a JSON file, one key or index per line; long for type and size.

json_search.json.description: Tool json_search: find a key and/or value below a place (or in the levels above it); one FILE#/POINTER per hit.

json_set.json.description: Tool json_set: set one place in a JSON file to a value, exactly as given; /- appends.

json_add.json.description: Tool json_add: add a new key or array item (inserts); never overwrites (KeyExists).

json_del.json.description: Tool json_del: delete one key or array item from a JSON file.

json_len.json.description: Tool json_len: the length of one place: keys of an object, items of an array, characters of a string.

json_multi_get.json.description: Tool json_multi_get: several FILE#/POINTER at once, one line per place; failures per place, PlacesFailed at the end.

json_multi_set.json.description: Tool json_multi_set: set several places in order, one line per place; nothing undone if one fails.

index_view.json.description: Tool index_view: see a node through its index (KEY<TAB>description); a view, not the facts.

jsonx_get.json.description: Tool jsonx_get: json_get for aos configuration files: follow $ref, resolve $ref/$env.

jsonx_ls.json.description: Tool jsonx_ls: json_ls for aos configuration files: follow $ref, list the resolved value.

jsonx_search.json.description: Tool jsonx_search: json_search for aos configuration files: follow $ref, search the resolved value.

jsonx_set.json.description: Tool jsonx_set: json_set for aos configuration files: value, text or from; follow, resolve, check.

jsonx_add.json.description: Tool jsonx_add: json_add for aos configuration files, with the options of jsonx_set.

jsonx_del.json.description: Tool jsonx_del: json_del for aos configuration files: $ref on the way protected unless follow.

jsonx_multi_get.json.description: Tool jsonx_multi_get: json_multi_get read like jsonx_get (follow, resolve for every place).

jsonx_multi_set.json.description: Tool jsonx_multi_set: json_multi_set done like jsonx_set: value, text or from per item; follow, resolve, check for all.

trash.json.description: Tool trash: delete so it can be undone (moved into .trash/ in your workspace).

remove.json.description: Tool remove: delete for real, like rm; no undo (a folder needs recursive).

shell.json.description: Tool shell: run one bash command line in your workspace; output ends with [exit code N].

run_python.json.description: Tool run_python: run a short Python 3 program; output ends with [exit code N].

peek_clock.json.description: Tool peek_clock: the daemon clock's current cycle and how many ms one cycle is.

peek_now_time.json.description: Tool peek_now_time: the current time of day in UTC.

math.json.description: Tool math: compute one arithmetic expression; what is allowed, examples, ExprBad.

todo.json.description: Tool todo: your own to-do list for a long task (ls, set, add, mark); kept outside your history.

goal.json.description: Tool goal: your goal, reminded when you stop by yourself; set, done, pause, resume.

_description.json.description: One node per stock tool: what it does, when to use it, its arguments, examples with real output and errors; packs are in aos/packs.json.
